name: payments
title: Payments
description: Provider-agnostic checkout, customer portal and webhooks (Stripe adapter), with a mock provider so billing works locally with zero keys.

env.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
env.description: Stripe secret key. Unset in development = mock provider with a fake checkout at /dev/checkout

env.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
env.description: Signing secret of the webhook endpoint <site>/api/payments/webhook
env.howTo: Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks, or `stripe listen --forward-to localhost:3000/api/payments/webhook`

payment-webhooks.description: Handlers for normalized payment events (billing → subscriptions, store → orders).

postInstall: Development: no keys needed. Checkouts open a mock payment page at /dev/checkout.
Production: set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET; subscribe the webhook to checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.* and invoice.payment_failed.
